configurations.comment: autoPort because 5173 is often taken by another project. The browser never sees this port: it loads the app through the editor proxy on 3000, so _auth.js ALLOWED_ORIGINS is satisfied by 3000 regardless of what Vite binds to.
configurations.name: brandgeo-dashboard

configurations.comment: Editor overlay in front of the Vite dashboard. Port 3000 is not arbitrary: netlify/functions/_auth.js ALLOWED_ORIGINS whitelists only app.getbrandgeo.com, localhost:5173 and localhost:3000, so any other port would be rejected by every API call and login would fail. Start brandgeo-dashboard first; this proxies it.
configurations.name: brandgeo-dashboard-editor

configurations.comment: Demo mode: `vite --mode demo` picks up .env.demo.local, whose placeholder Supabase URL flips isDemoMode on, so every signed-in page renders mock data with no login. Added for the UI/UX audit; harmless to leave, it changes nothing about the normal brandgeo-dashboard entry.
configurations.name: brandgeo-dashboard-demo
